name: Obsession
source:
Tired, scared, and alone, you stumble into the forest. Someone or something is hunting you. Every decision could save your life… or end it. Will you survive the night?

[From [url=https://selyk-alien.itch.io/obsession]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
疲倦、害怕、孤独，你跌跌撞撞地走进了森林。有人或某事正在追捕你。每一个决定都可能挽救你的生命……或者结束你的生命。你能活过这个夜晚吗？

[来自[url=https://selyk-alien.itch.io/obsession]Itch.io[/url]]
